data.title: 鸿雪 · 杜林诗卷里的未竟章节
data.action: 侧身坐在红木书桌前，修长双腿在裙摆开叉下斜倚，狼耳与蓬松尾巴在微光下泛着银粉光泽，钢笔轻点唇瓣，目光深情如诗。
data.location: 罗德岛私人书房，古旧皮面精装书堆叠至屋顶，打字机上夹着未写完的诗篇
data.lighting: 复古黄铜绿罩台灯在厚重羊皮纸与丝绒裙上洒下浓郁温润的金绿暖调
data.mood: 贵族文豪的忧郁浪漫与只对一人倾注的至深眷恋
data.description: 罗德岛私人书房，古旧皮面精装书堆叠至屋顶，打字机上夹着未写完的诗篇。侧身坐在红木书桌前，修长双腿在裙摆开叉下斜倚，狼耳与蓬松尾巴在微光下泛着银粉光泽，钢笔轻点唇瓣，目光深情如诗。 她微微抬眸轻语——“在纯白雪原的深处，我曾以为文字是我唯一的庇护所……直到博士你，读懂了我所有未写完的段落。”
data.promptProse: Pozyomka sits sideways at a mahogany desk inside her private book-lined study on an autumn night, wearing a deep raspberry-burgundy velvet corseted slip dress edged with vintage cream lace and a high side slit. Touching a fountain pen softly to her lips beside a vintage typewriter and manuscript pages, she looks toward the viewer under warm brass lamplight.
data.animaCaption: Seated sideways at a mahogany study desk in a burgundy velvet corseted slip dress with cream lace trim and a high slit, she touches a fountain pen to her lips beside an open typewriter manuscript and gazes tenderly toward the viewer. A green-shaded brass banker lamp bathes the book-lined room in rich golden warmth.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a deep raspberry-burgundy velvet corseted slip dress trimmed with vintage cream lace and a high side slit showing her bare legs.
